summary: CCH Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company operating Malaysian restaurant chain Chicken Clay Pot House, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 3, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting. Shareholders holding 13,632,419.10 ordinary shares (61,260,419.10 votes) out of 19,815,727 outstanding shares formed a quorum and duly passed all resolutions, including adoption of the Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. The exhibit reflects routine corporate governance changes (amended articles, authorized capital structure with Class A and Class B shares). This is a routine EGM results notice with no special-situation transaction; no deal terms, premiums, or transactions were announced.
